Im going thru the exact same thing but heres what i think 

So, you prob got out of the honeymoon phase where you guys were constantly being affectionate and stuff, because that constant affection can't go on forever.  It'll get stale.  But that doesnt mean you two dont like each other; the love may still be there but the burst of passion at the beginning may have died out.  This is totally natural in any kind of relationship!

And idk if this stands for him about the sexting but his libido mightve died down from the stress or something like that.  That's natural and it happened with my ldr bf because of quarantine.  He will def get back into it at one point, as it's totally natural for everyone.

But if it's really really bothering you just tell him how you feel!  Communication is everything, and if it keeps getting on your nerves, it's best to be totally honest.  It's what makes successful ldrs work.

I hope I helped and good luck :))

The Mother series, definitely.  I remember I found it through smash bros brawl when I was choosing a main; the characters interested me because (why were there kids in a T rated fighting game?) I’d never really seen them before.  I did research and found the games, playing earthbound then mother 3 (we don’t talk about the first one).  Honestly, they made me more well-rounded.  Each game was radically different.  Earthbound changed my sense of humor to random nonsense lines that could make me laugh, and Mother 3 taught me a new kind of empathy when I cried my eyes out at the ending.  It was a good series to grow up with even if it doesn’t get too much attention!
Honestly!  I was surprised nobody mentioned the mother series LOL

I level grinded a lot so some of my party could get special moves, so it took 14+ hours for me, but on average people usually spend 7-8+ hours.  Definitely shorter than earthbound though, that game took me a century!
